args.summary: Decision: PROMOTE. Evidence from the raw log: zero 5xx and zero non-200 on both versions (7343 stable / 2476 canary requests); the canary's slowness is confined to warm-up (0-30s canary p95 210ms vs stable 93ms), and from 60s on it matches stable (canary n=1261 p50=36 p95=94 p99=104 vs stable n=3651 p50=34 p95=95 p99=104), including /checkout (canary n=268 p50=79 p95=103 vs stable p50=83 p95=104); >150ms requests cluster in the canary's first 30s (272) and nearly vanish after 60s (6 vs stable 16). Judgement: single-pod cold-start artifact, not a regression, so promote in stages with alerting that tolerates ~30s of elevated p95 per newly-ready pod and rolls back if it persists past ~60s or any 5xx appear. Written to review/A-evidence-2/decision.json with five verifiable claims.
